save_model_checkpoint: save a PyTorch model with optimizer and scheduler state to a checkpoint directory
load_model_checkpoint: load a pretrained model with optimizer and scheduler from a saved checkpoint path
create_warmup_linear_scheduler: create a warmup linear learning rate scheduler with configurable warmup steps and min ratio
init_logger_distributed: initialize a logging instance with optional file output and distributed training support
load_passages_from_tsv: load tab-separated passage data from a TSV file into a list of tuples
